bandsNote: drafted 2026-10-12 by scripts/bands.mjs off the released default page (/): each kept band that is not a picture wears the system's ground (src/bands.mjs), its words keep their colours; the inner pages’ page-title band (.ja-masthead) and their call band above the footer (.cta-showcase-item, "JOIN THIS MONTH") are duotones: a photo multiplied over a fill, white words on it. The masthead’s fill followed the accent while its title took the page text (dark on a dark duotone under light systems), the call band’s fill is a literal #dd2222 that stayed the template red (visual review 14/10/2026). Both are bands that keep their white words and wear a ground of the system on which those words read (the accent, else its ink); the masthead’s accent word takes the accent made readable there. The home page’s class strip (#Section94 .features-img) is the same duotone over the accent: under a light accent its white labels sat on yellow (Mailchimp, Linear). Its fill is the band’s accent fill (a band variable, --fit-duotone) mixed 40% toward black (sideRules, both sides: a kept band resets the system’s roles, so the mix reads the band variable); 14/10/2026 (visual review, round 3): #Section98 was a band of its own (a picture band on the template red) around the call band .cta-showcase-item, the same 1440×176 box on every page: its rules, keyed by an id, outweighed the call band’s, so the button was judged on the template red (15% lighter) instead of the ground it sits on and came out a black fill on the near-black duotone under Moxie (label readable, shape lost). #Section98 is no longer a band; the call band alone wears the system, and its button is judged on its own worn ground
